pages.text: World serverconfig/tutorial_mod-gameplay.toml controls armor pieces, toughness, immunity, energy, shield, domains, wave speed/multiplier, elite chance, ore generation, maintenance, recycling, reinforcement, friendly fire, death retention, budgets and environment. Forge synchronizes these settings.

Existing gain/decay/range/cap settings remain in config/tutorial_mod-common.toml; HUD settings remain in config/tutorial_mod-hud.toml. Generation only affects new chunks. Restart the world after changes.$(br2)serverconfig/tutorial_mod-gameplay.toml
